alex: Quick logistics thread for the SF offsite — shuttle + snacks + rooming prefs. Super quick poll, promise :sweat_smile:
alex: Shuttle options: 7:15 pickup (arrive 8:30), 8:30 pickup (arrive 9:45). Which do you want? Reply with 7 or 8.
sara: 8 pls, sleep > early :coffee:
mike: 7 — got meetings right after, can always nap on the bus :zzz:
jen: 8 for me. also any veg/vegan snack requests? I'm bringing a snack stash.
tom: Vegan + nut-free please (allergic). thanks!
alex: Noted. Also rooming — @jen @sara do you want to room together? could swap to keep costs down.
jen: happy to room with sara. :thumbsup:
sara: I'll take it if jen's fine. thx!
mike: If anyone wants a quieter room, I'm the one who snores the least :wink:
calendar-bot: Reminder: shuttle schedule posted -> https://calendar.redwood.example/offsite-shuttle
calendar-bot: Shuttle snippet:
``` 
7:15am - Lobby A (Hotel X)
8:30am - Main Gate (Hotel Y)
Return: 6:00pm - Lobby A
```
alex: Also quick poll on carry-on vs check bag for flight home — reply "carry" or "check".
jen: carry
tom: check (souvenirs incoming)
mike: carry
sara: carry
alex: Cool. I'll compile and DM ops to order vegan + nut-free snack box. Also putting together a mini travel tip doc: bring power strip, light jacket, and noise-cancelling earplugs.
mike: also pocket hand sanitizer :soap:
jen: meme (link) https://imgur.example/funny-packing.jpg :joy:
alex: thanks all. final plan by EOD, ping me if you need to change shuttle.
